item.title: Chennai Power Cut: No Electricity For 5 hours in Over 50 Locations Today - Is your Area Affected?

item.title: Elon Musk Predicts an AI Healthcare Revolution - Doctors Explain What’s Already Changing
item.description: Elon Musk has sparked debate by claiming AI could soon deliver healthcare better than what world leaders receive. Doctors say this shift is already underway, with AI enhancing surgery, diagnostics, and cancer care. While AI won’t replace physicians, experts agree it can improve precision, access, and outcomes, especially in overburdened systems like India’s.
